title: Rectifiability theorem for currents (Simon 8.1)
statement: For all P, m ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and every T ∈ D_{m+1}(U) with M_W(T) + M_W(∂T) < ∞ for all W ⊂⊂ U: if some measure μ with IsMassMeasure T μ has upper density Θ*^{m+1}(μ, x) > 0 for μ-a.e. x, then T = τ(M, θ, ξ) is rectifiable (IsRectifiableCurrent T: M countably (m+1)-rectifiable and Hⁿ-measurable in U, θ > 0 locally integrable, ξ orienting the weighted approximate tangent spaces).
